scripts.preflight: npm run preflight:go && npm run preflight:build && npm run preflight:secrets
scripts.preflight:go: go vet ./... && go test -timeout 180s ./... && go run github.com/securego/gosec/v2/cmd/gosec@latest -quiet -conf .gosec.json -exclude-dir=ui/node_modules ./...
scripts.preflight:secrets: gitleaks detect --source . --no-banner 2>&1 && echo 'secrets: OK' || echo 'gitleaks: SKIP (not installed)'
